title: [Shopify] Expose Product facade procedures for Add to Shopify parity
summary: Three new public procedures are added to the Shopify Product facade to enable partners to reproduce the native Add to Shopify flow when extending the connector, including shop confirmation, attribute compatibility checking, and product URL retrieval.
key_points: ConfirmAddItemToShopify exposes shop confirmation and multi-shop selection
CheckItemAttributesCompatibleForProductOptions validates item attributes for Shopify product options
GetProductUrl retrieves the URL for an item and shop combination
Facade delegates to existing internal implementations without changing them
Enables partner extensions to match the native Add to Shopify action behavior
